svg.title: File sync system deep dive architecture
svg.desc: Two-plane architecture showing metadata plane and content plane with key deep-dive components: chunking engine, block store with CDC, sync engine with vector clocks, and notification layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the client-side chunking engine for Dropbox-style systems')
sendPrompt('What does the client sync engine do in Dropbox-style systems?')
sendPrompt('What is the role of the upload orchestrator in a chunked upload system?')
sendPrompt('How does the metadata service in Dropbox handle file versioning and namespace?')
sendPrompt('How does a sync conflict resolution engine work with vector clocks?')
sendPrompt('How does the notification / long-poll layer work for file sync?')
sendPrompt('How does content-defined chunking (CDC) work and why is it better than fixed-size chunks?')
sendPrompt('How does block-level deduplication work in a distributed file storage system?')
sendPrompt('How does blob storage work with tiered hot and cold storage for a file sync system?')

svg.text: Deep dive zones — click to explore

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does resumable chunked upload work end-to-end in a system like Dropbox?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does delta sync work — what exactly is transmitted when a file changes?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does conflict resolution work when two clients edit the same file offline?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does cross-user deduplication work safely — what are the security concerns with convergent encryption?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does the metadata database schema handle file versioning, soft deletes, and shared folders?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how do you design the notification system for file sync to avoid missed updates and thundering herds?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how does access control and sharing work at scale for a file system like Google Drive?')
sendPrompt('Deep dive: how do you handle large file uploads — multi-part, chunked, presigned URLs — what are the tradeoffs?')
